How team counters are ranked

The 17 checked counter forms are scored against every selected enemy separately, using the same individual element factors as the main lookup. “Advantage” means the selected verified move has at least one advantageous element matchup and no resisted element matchup, with no known block or unconfirmed airborne reach. Mixed and resisted matchups remain visible; no combined damage multiplier is assumed.

Overall ranking prioritizes advantage coverage, then fewer blocked, reach-unconfirmed, resisted and mixed matchups, Spatial advantages, DPS role, fewer incoming elemental weaknesses and base ATK. Enemy elements do not establish which attacks it will use. Level, gear, skills and combat execution can change the outcome.

The suggested coverage group greedily adds up to three counter forms that cover additional enemies. It is a coverage suggestion, not an exhaustive optimal team search. Forms of the same species are shown as alternatives. A ranged move is blocked against an active Tunnel enemy; a non-ranged listed move has unconfirmed reach against Fly. Recommendations are limited to the curated roster; the searchable enemy index is broader. Read the main app’s data notes for source and model limits.
